binding_rules.observation: Use ON for subsequent stages unless mean run-level P95 grows by >max(2ms,5% of OFF mean) OR absolute mean fresh-rate difference >max(0.02, OFF replicate range); otherwise use OFF and report failed disturbance qualification. Passing this gate is not proof of zero observer effect.
binding_rules.eager_bow: Prefer ON after native validation unless an ON run fails input/completion/correctness, ON mean fresh-rate is lower than OFF by >max(0.02,OFF replicate range), or ON mean P95>100ms while OFF mean P95<=100ms. On failure use OFF and retain fix qualification failure.
binding_rules.matrix: All eight use the same code, package and once-selected switches. No edits to source or inputs between runs.

parameter_candidate_screening.input_complete: Both replicates must process all5878 exact identities.
parameter_candidate_screening.quality: Both candidate replicates nonfresh count <=0.70 * mean P0 nonfresh count. Compare both means and replicate variation; retain all outcomes.
parameter_candidate_screening.latency: P95<100ms for10Hz; report P99 and >100ms counts plus overall latency, queues and memory. Does not replace prior90ms project qualification.
parameter_candidate_screening.trajectory: Reject diagnosed wrong relocalization/pose jumps; no ground truth available, so no ATE/RPE or metric accuracy qualification.
parameter_candidate_screening.none_pass: Keep P0 as reference, no claimed improvement; inspect measured losses instead of adding features indefinitely.

execution_policy.resume: Only skip already sealed complete rounds; never silently replay a failed/invalid round.
execution_policy.run_failure: Stop next round, preserve all logs, correct infrastructure if necessary and document the event before proceeding; no selective successful reruns.
execution_policy.workload: Finish builds, native tests, input hashing and bulk analysis before timed playback. Only lightweight control/status and documented resource observers during playback.
execution_policy.later_stages: ThDepth/depth-filter/capture experiments are conditional on evidence and hardware/data availability; do not fake unknown distance truth or higher-fps data.

publication: Code/configuration and aggregate comparison can be committed to the existing GitHub repository; source bag/images remain local.
